idea-plugin.name: MyDebug HotReload
idea-plugin.description:
Save a file and see the change in the running Java application instantly — no restart, with or without the debugger.

MyDebug HotReload compiles what you saved and reloads it into the running JVM. A small bundled agent then refreshes Spring and MyBatis so new endpoints, injected fields and SQL changes are live right away.

  • Reload on save — Ctrl+S compiles incrementally and reloads; bursts of saves are batched. Works in Run mode too: the agent watches the build output and redefines changed classes itself.
  • Spring — new or changed @GetMapping/@PostMapping endpoints are mapped, new @Autowired/@Value fields are injected into the existing beans, and brand-new @Service/@RestController classes are registered as beans.
  • MyBatis — edited mapper XML files are re-parsed into the running configuration.
  • Structural changes — on JetBrains Runtime / DCEVM, -XX:+AllowEnhancedClassRedefinition is added automatically, so adding or removing methods and fields reloads too. The JDK is probed first; unsupported JDKs are left untouched.
  • Fast — native file notifications instead of polling, one batched redefinition per build, typical reloads in tens of milliseconds.

Settings: Settings | Tools | MyDebug HotReload. Actions: Run | MyDebug: Reload on Save and Run | MyDebug: Compile and Reload Now (Ctrl+Alt+F9).
